title: Prime Minister congratulates Seema on winning Bronze Medal in Women’s 10,000m at Asian Games
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today expressed his pride in Seema for winning the Bronze Medal in the Women’s 10,000m event at the Asian Games and congratulated her on the achievement.
The Prime Minister stated that her determined performance has brought India a medal in this event after many years. Shri Modi noted that it is a wonderful achievement reflecting endurance, discipline, and years of hard work. He further extended his wishes for her to achieve many more successes in the times ahead.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"Proud of Seema on winning the Bronze Medal in the Women’s 10,000m at the Asian Games! Congrats to her.
Her determined performance has brought India a medal in this event after many years. A wonderful achievement that reflects endurance, discipline and years of hard work.
Wishing her many more successes in the times ahead: PM @narendramodi"
